01 — AI mark & grade analyser

Know where every student stands before the exam does.

Enter your paper class marks and Calcus works out each student’s Z-score, tracks progress paper by paper and predicts a likely A/L grade — so you can push each student closer to the grade they need.

  • Z-scores calculated across your whole class
  • Predicted national exam grade for every student
  • Weak topics flagged from paper results
  • Class-wide view of who needs attention

Predictions are estimates to guide revision, not guaranteed results.

02 — Your own subject AI

An AI that teaches the way you do.

We train a custom AI model for your subject on what you’ve taught in class, the Sri Lankan syllabus and past papers. Students ask in Sinhala, Tamil or English and get answers in the same language — in your method, not a generic one.

  • Trained on your notes, tutes and paper classes
  • Follows the local syllabus and past paper style
  • Answers natively in Sinhala, Tamil and English
  • Available to your students day and night

What’s in the package

Everything below is included as standard. The number of classes, users, pages and initial materials is agreed in your quote.

  1. 01

    Teacher website

    Profile, qualifications, subjects, teaching approach, timetable and contact details — designed for phones first.

  2. 02

    Class pages & enquiries

    A page for each class, a registration enquiry form and a WhatsApp button so parents can reach you directly.

  3. 03

    Students & attendance

    Student directory, class groups and enrolment records, with attendance marked per class in one private admin area.

  4. 04

    Learning materials

    Upload notes and worksheets, and link your existing lesson videos, organised by class.

  5. 05

    Fees & reports

    Record class fees and payment status, with simple student, attendance and fee reports.

  6. 06

    Launch & training

    Setup with your supplied content, basic search engine setup, admin training and a handover guide.

How we work with you

A clear scope and price up front, and you see the site before it goes live.

  1. Step 1

    Consultation

    We talk through your subjects, classes, student numbers and what you want to manage online. You get a written scope and a fixed quote.

  2. Step 2

    Design, content & AI setup

    We design your site around your teaching brand, load your class details, and prepare your notes, papers and syllabus material for any AI features you choose.

  3. Step 3

    Build & review

    We build the website, admin area and AI tools, then walk you through them so you can test answers and request changes before launch.

  4. Step 4

    Launch & training

    We put the site live, train you (and any staff) on the admin area and hand over a short guide for day-to-day use.

Questions teachers ask

Something else? Call us on +94 70 184 0527.

What does the LKR 80,000 cover?

It is the starting price for the standard package: the teacher website and the admin area for students, attendance, materials and fees, plus setup and training. The final price depends on your number of classes, students, pages and features, and is agreed with you before work begins.

Are there any recurring costs?

Some services carry ongoing or usage-based costs — for example your domain name, hosting, video storage, SMS or WhatsApp messaging, payment processing and AI usage. We list every cost that applies to your setup in your quote.

How are the A/L grade predictions worked out?

The analyser uses each student’s paper class marks, compares them with the rest of your class using Z-scores, and estimates a likely grade range. Predictions are a guide for revision planning, not a guaranteed result — they become more reliable as more papers are marked.

What does the subject AI learn from?

From what you teach: your class notes, tutes and papers, together with the Sri Lankan syllabus and past papers for your subject. It answers students in Sinhala, Tamil or English, and you can review its answers before it goes live.

Does it work for O/L, scholarship and online classes too?

Yes. The website, student records, attendance, materials and fee features work for any class — Grade 5 scholarship, O/L, A/L, university, language, music or online classes, for individual tutors and tuition institutes anywhere in Sri Lanka. Z-scores and grade predictions are built around A/L; for other exams the analyser tracks marks and each student’s standing in the class.

Can the website be in Sinhala or Tamil?

Yes. Sinhala, Tamil and English versions are available as an optional extra for the website, materials and student experience.

I run a small class. Is this too much for me?

No. The package is scoped to your size, and pricing is negotiable. Many teachers start with the website and student records and add features later.
